summary: Frontend-only end-to-end validation of Farms & Paddocks CRUD and QR sign-off on completed spray records. All 16 review points passed. Farms list renders 2 seeded farms with correct paddock counts (3 and 2). Full CRUD verified: create farm -> routes to detail; edit rename reflects in header + list; add/edit/delete paddock reflects in count; delete-farm gating (button hidden when paddocks > 0 with 'Remove all paddocks before deleting this farm.' hint) is correct. New Spray Job form picks up newly created farm chip. Completed records show 'Completed' badge + 'Sign-Off QR' section with tappable preview that expands a QR (SVG rendered, 3 child nodes), correct caption 'Scan to verify this spray job at the paddock gate.', truncated 'Record ID: XXXXXXXX' (8 chars), and Share Record button (clicked without crash on web). Draft-status record shows no Completed badge and no QR block. Seeded record fields (Job, Application, Starting weather, Chemicals, Notes) all render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: records/[id].tsx: buildSignOffPayload runs on every render regardless of QR expansion; minor perf nit, consider useMemo (non-blocking).
farms/paddock-edit.tsx: Delete Paddock has no confirmation dialog (Alert.alert) - one tap deletes immediately. Consider adding confirmation for destructive action (non-blocking, works on web).
farms/[id].tsx: same for Delete Farm - no confirmation prompt.
more.tsx: testID 'tool-link-farms-&-paddocks' contains '&' - works but consider sanitizing special chars in testID generation.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test data during Playwright run (ChipTest Farm + ChipTest Paddock, plus injected draft/active jobs via localStorage). Data lives in AsyncStorage/localStorage of the automated browser session and is not persisted server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AsyncStorage-only app; seed_v3 key gates seeding. To test QR visibility on non-completed jobs, inject a spray job into localStorage 'as.spray_jobs' with status='draft' or 'active' then navigate to /records/<id>. QR renders as SVG via react-native-qrcode-svg on web. Share.share on web falls back silently - just verifies no crash.
